jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Rutland Town School District, a town school district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member town: Rutland Town). Distinct from the Rutland City School District.
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site).

board.post_note: Rutland Town SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot. Two seats are held (see the source note).

sources.note: Town of Rutland FY2025 Annual Report (official): the elected-officials table (p. 59) publishes the five school directors with terms -- Hammond 2024-2026 (Chair), Fingon 2023-2026, Colomb 2024-2027, Mullin 2025-2027 (Clerk), Hamilton 2025-2028 -- and the district warning printed in the same report (p. 80) warns exactly two seats for the March 3, 2026 Australian ballot (one 2-year, one 3-year), matching Hammond's and Fingon's expiring terms. HELD: Hammond and Fingon (their published terms expired at that election; no certified return or post-election roster was fetched -- resolving documents: the certified March 3, 2026 return or post-March 2026 RTS minutes naming members).

directors.name: Linda Mullin
